items.description: Report gives no numeric values for market value, cost basis, or the merged basis, so the exact inflation magnitude cannot be computed; only the reported relation (merged basis equals or exceeds market value) is encoded.
Report does not state whether the withdrawal is a separate action or part of the same flow, so the fee-elimination step is not bound to a checkpoint.
Report gives no numeric market value, cost basis, or fee amount, so the profit/fee relation is represented by grounded Boolean observables rather than numeric comparisons.
Report does not state whether withdrawal is a separate action or part of the same flow as the transfer.
Report does not specify exact numeric values for market value, cost basis, or fee amounts, so the fee relation is represented qualitatively.
Report does not state whether the withdrawal step is a separate action or part of the same flow.

The report does not define an observable numeric or structural relation that distinguishes a legitimate share transfer from creation of a secondary market for losing basis; the impact is stated only as a qualitative market outcome.
Report gives no numeric values for market value, cost basis, or fee amounts, so the basis-inflation and fee-elimination magnitudes cannot be bound.
